title: Set [parallel] max_concurrency = 1 in athena.toml as a disk stopgap
summary: Part 1 of 2: change athena.toml [parallel] max_concurrency from 2 to 1 so only one per-job build folder exists at a time, fixing low-disk holds and skipped D182 checks until part 2 lands. Update the comment, pin the repository value in a test, and record the reason in a new decision. Goal: the owner (Sri) and the drain stop tripping the low-disk gate.

defaults_applied.how: cargo test and clippy must pass with the new pin test
criteria check the value drain reads, not just the file edit
one focused config change, no drain logic edits
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-data/src/config.rs (validate at ~794 accepts 1..=MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING; tests at ~1812-1846 use REPO_CONFIG and only range-check the real file, with no test pinning 2) and crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs:953 (type only). grep found no Rust test asserting the repository value 2, so a small test pinning 1 is added to give the stopgap a mechanism.
Consumers: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs (Config::parse of athena.toml), drain in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs reads parallel.max_concurrency.
docs/design/async-drain.md and agent-and-build-slots.md mention the value 2 as history; they are left unchanged as design records.

The new decision is appended to docs/decisions.md with a Provenance bullet, names part 2 as the replacement, and says to restore concurrency when per-job build folders are bounded; no existing entry is edited.
Field meaning: parallel.max_concurrency, 'How many jobs athena drain runs at once' (athena.toml:201), 1 = one job at a time; live value is 2 before and 1 after.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [parallel] sets max_concurrency = 1 (diff line replacing `max_concurrency = 2`) and its comment no longer says 'Set to 2 here', stating it is a disk stopgap until part 2.

A unit test in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs parses the shipped REPO_CONFIG and asserts parallel.max_concurrency == 1; `cargo test -p athena-data` passes, and the test fails if athena.toml is set back to 2.
`cargo test` passes for the whole workspace, with no remaining test that expects the repository value 2.
`cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.

docs/decisions.md gets a new appended decision with a Provenance bullet recording why: two 15-24 GB build folders on a one-folder disk, 14 low-disk holds, 6 of 12 producer passes skipping D182 checks; stopgap until part 2. No existing entry is edited.
CHANGELOG.md records the change in a new entry.

out_of_scope: Part 2: bounding or sharing per-job build folders
Changing max_check_slots or the low-disk gate logic
departures: Small mechanical config change, so cost and time sit below the reference forecast.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time: stops low-disk holds, discarded finished work and skipped pre-verifier checks (14 holds this week).
